title: Finer sub-Planck structures and displacement sensitivity of SU(1,1) circular states
summary: Quantum states with sub-Planck features exhibit sensitivity to phase-space displacements beyond the standard quantum limit, making them useful for quantum metrology. In the context of the SU(1,1) group, sub-Planck features have been constructed through the superposition of four Perelomov coherent states on the hyperbolic plane (the SU(1,1) compass state). However, these structures differ in scale along different phase-space directions (anisotropic features), resulting in nonuniform sensitivity enhancement to phase-space displacements.
